label: prop:skein-generation
title: Skein generation of hadrons from mass-zero fundamentals
html:
Let (\mathbf{C}, A, \tau) be a quantum observable universe with substrate parameter q and Skein module \mathrm{Sk}_q = \mathrm{Sk}_q(\mathbf{C}). The Skein module \mathrm{Sk}_q is generated as an algebra by:

  1. The fundamental (mass-zero) knot types \{K_i\}_{i \in \mathcal{F}} (torus knots), and
  2. The Hopf link \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{Hopf}} (the binding operation).

Every hadron admits a terminal Skein resolution into a finite polynomial in these generators with coefficients in \mathbb{Z}[q^{\pm 1}].
